Baku Baku.name: Baku Baku
Baku Baku.summary: In Baku Baku, the objective is to defeat your opponent by filling their screen to the top with garbage blocks. The gameplay revolves around a unique mechanic where you stack falling blocks of food, like bananas or bamboo, into large clusters, then drop the corresponding animal, like a monkey or panda, next to them. The animal devours the food, clearing the blocks and sending heavy garbage blocks over to your rival's screen to force a loss.
